article.story: DURHAM, N.H. -- — Comeh Emuobor scored 12 points and grabbed 10 rebounds as New Hampshire beat Stonehill 59-58 on Wednesday. KiJan Robinson made a pair of free throws with 16 seconds left to give New Hampshire a 59-56 lead. Stonehill's Ridvan Tutic then tipped in Hermann Koffi's 3-point attempt at the buzzer. Emuobor added four steals for the Wildcats (4-7). Reginald Kennedy Jr. scored 10 points, going 4 of 5 from the field. Jack Graham finished with 10 points. Tutic led the way for the Skyhawks (3-9) with 21 points and 10 rebounds. Koffi added 10 points. Rex Sunderland and Chas Stinson scored eight points apiece for Stonehill. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
